title: wolfSSL 3.10.2 X.509 certificate text parsing off-by-one
bug_class: X.509 certificate text parsing off-by-one out-of-bounds byte overwrite
expected_vulnerable_behavior: On wolfSSL v3.10.2-stable with ASan/UBSan and --enable-opensslextra, the reconstructed PoC certificate triggers AddressSanitizer stack-buffer-overflow: WRITE of size 1 in wolfSSL_X509_NAME_get_text_by_NID at src/ssl.c:12471, overflowing the 80-byte localityName stack buffer.
expected_fixed_behavior: wolfSSL v3.11.0-stable executes the minimal certfields harness on the reconstructed CVE-2017-2800 certificate without ASan stack-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 1, or abort. Exit code is 0.
expected_current_behavior: Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1299-geeab53205 executes the minimal certfields harness on the reconstructed CVE-2017-2800 certificate without ASan stack-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 1, or abort. Exit code is 0.
crash_signal: ASan stack-buffer-overflow; WRITE of size 1; wolfSSL_X509_NAME_get_text_by_NID src/ssl.c:12471; localityName stack buffer overflow; exit code 134.
migration_value: High. X.509 certificate string-field parsing can be migrated to OpenSSL and mbedTLS X.509 name/text printing and parsing APIs.
notes: Strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v3.10.2-stable using a reconstructed certificate generated from the public Exploit-DB/Talos PoC OpenSSL command. The input is not the original attached certificate bytes, but it preserves the published trigger structure and reproduces the reported ASan stack-buffer-overflow in wolfSSL_X509_NAME_get_text_by_NID. Fixed release candidate verified: wolfSSL v3.11.0-stable does not reproduce the ASan stack-buffer-overflow observed on v3.10.2-stable under the same minimal certfields harness and ASan/UBSan configuration. The first build attempt failed because -Werror promoted compiler warnings to errors; after removing -Werror from Makefile, the library built successfully. These build warnings are unrelated to the CVE-2017-2800 runtime PoC behavior. Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1299-geeab53205 commit eeab53205ab57451778f7a76aad25f5349547ce5 was tested with the same reconstructed CVE-2017-2800 certificate and minimal certfields harness under ASan/UBSan. No ASan stack-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 1, or abort was observed.
